source.name: ProCyclingUK: Human Powered Health unveil new 2026 jersey
source.quote: At the centre of the jersey sits the Human Powered Health logo, supported by Verge, HumanGO, Wahoo, and long-term backer Kelly Benefits across the upper chest.
source.note: The team's own launch post (https://humanpoweredhealthcycling.com/news/human-powered-health-partners-with-verge-sport-for-new-look-in-2026/) uses the same wording: 'The Human Powered Health logo takes center stage, paired with Verge, HumanGO, Wahoo and long-term supporters Kelly Benefits, featured prominently across the upper chest.' The Inner Ring (2026-08-05) describes Human Powered Health as the title sponsor and a subsidiary of Optum, part of UnitedHealth Group.

summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam kit by new apparel partner Verge Sport, revealed 5 January 2026 and raced from the Santos Tour Down Under: the trademark warm-to-cool gradient with a new 'Tailwind' texture, the Human Powered Health logo at the centre of the chest flanked by Verge, HumanGO, Wahoo and long-term backer Kelly Benefits across the upper chest, and wheel and bike partners Black Inc and Factor Bikes on the sleeves. Kept incomplete: the launch texts only document chest and sleeve placements — the back, bib shorts and any patch placements could not be verified against the garment photos (Verge's replica product photos: https://www.vergesport.com/products/human-powered-health-strike-4-1-jersey-women) by a text-only check.
